small_talk: Just chat, and see what {name} offers
talk_note: Pick a topic from the notebook. Ask people about their own doings and they will mostly deny it, and remember you were asking. When nothing comes of it, they may point you to someone else.

archive_unpointed: Nothing in the notebook points to these records; you'll likely come up empty.
keeper_trusts: {name} trusts you and will let you look.
keeper_bribe: {name} doesn't know you well. It'll take five dollars.
ask_done: {text} (you've heard all the town knows; asking again only adds a witness)
